reviews.author: Toby

reviews.title: NZXT uses proprietary connections. Be aware of this.
reviews.comment: Great controller with multiple ports. However, NZXT uses proprietary connections for their RGB/Fan cables which you need to keep in mind when deciding on which brand fans/rgb’s to use in your PC. You may need to connect your AIO cooler and/or other fans/rgb’s directly to your motherboard depending on your setup. I use this controller for all of my NZXT fans & rgb’s but I connected my AIO cooler fan and rgb as well as the NZXT 140mm rgb back fan to my motherboard headers. You may need to find adapter cables that will convert the proprietary NZXT 4-pin rgb connectors to your motherboard or else you will want to buy all NZXT products in order for them to use this NZXT Controller which is what NZXT wants you to do. Hence the proprietary connections.
reviews.author: Dean S.

reviews.title: Easy Setup and Reliable Control for RGB & Fans
reviews.comment:
This NZXT control hub has worked really well for managing both my RGB lighting and PWM fans. The setup was straightforward — everything connected cleanly, and the software recognized the hub immediately. If you want a cleaner, more organized PC build, this makes a big difference.
What I like most is the reliability. No random disconnects, no flickering lights, and no issues with fan curves. Once you set your lighting and cooling profiles, they stay consistent. The build quality also feels solid, not cheap or flimsy.
It’s a great choice if you want simple control over multiple RGB devices without clutter or extra cables. Overall, it does exactly what it promises and has made my setup look and run better.

reviews.title: PSU connector choice.
reviews.comment: Product works as advertised. Controll app is simple and functional. My only complaint would be that NZXT chose to use an 8 pin PCIE power connection instead of the more available SATA power connection.
